import os
base='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545471/attempts/cb5c46cb9eb34b0fb84b0c3660206bd3/system/state/workspace/programs'
os.makedirs(base,exist_ok=True)
def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(len(row)-2):
            if row[c]==row[c+2] and row[c]!=row[c+1]:
                # only fill if both endpoints represent the foreground marker
                out[r][c+1]=(row[c]+1)%10
    return out
test=[[3]*6,[3]*6,[5,3,5,3,3,3],[3]*6,[3,5,3,5,3,3]]
result=transform(test)
# save program
path=os.path.join(base,'task-c89012db.py')
with open(path,'w') as f: f.write('def transform(grid):\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    for r, row in enumerate(grid):\n        for c in range(len(row) - 2):\n            if row[c] == row[c + 2] and row[c] != row[c + 1]:\n                out[r][c + 1] = (row[c] + 1) % 10\n    return out\n')
print(result)
